data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 102.4m (2015: GBP 68.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 2.8m (2015: improvement of GBP 9.0m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Marine Liability with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve strengthening on Warranty & Indemnity losses reported in previous years in the Professional Lines account on the 2014 & Prior years of account.

named_events.loss_description: Increase in large claims across multiple lines most notably on the Energy, Marine and Reinsurance classes from the Jubilee (Tullow Ghana) claim.
Large claims activity including Space X impacted the Marine and Reinsurance classes.
Large claims activity including Vermillion (Samir oil refinery) impacted Energy and Marine classes.
Pemex-related claim noted as contributing to large loss activity across multiple lines.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves opened GBP 205.441m and experienced a net gross prior-year deterioration of approximately GBP 24.7m (12.0% of opening reserves), representing a strengthening of reserves. The deterioration was primarily driven by large-loss activity and adverse development in Professional Lines and Marine (and to a lesser extent Energy and specialty reinsurance impacts), partially offset by favourable development in other classes. Reinsurance recoveries mitigated some of the impact.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of GBP 2.8m (2015: improvement of GBP 9.0m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Marine Liability with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

an increase in large claims across multiple lines in the year most notably on the Energy, Marine and Reinsurance classes, from the Jubilee (Tullow Ghana), Space X, Vermillion (Samir oil refinery) and Pemex claims.
there has been reserve strengthening on Warranty & Indemnity losses reported in previous years in the Professional Lines account on the 2014 & Prior years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single-line 'Gross movement in prior year's provision' was provided in gross terms. Prior-year development has been calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross basis) per note 22. Report also quotes a net deterioration (GBP 2.8m) which is net of reinsurance; gross calculation from triangle yields GBP 24.745m strengthening. There was a reinsurance-to-close of the 2014 year into 2015 noted in the report (may affect certain year-of-account comparatives), but the triangle used is presented on a gross basis and was used per the prescribed fallback method.
